§6Hydraulic Fracking Tower§f

§aInfinite oil from bedrock, just do not build it near your base.§f

The §bHydraulic Fracking Tower§f is a massive multiblock that extracts crude oil and natural gas from bedrock deposits without depleting. It needs §bFracking Solution§f (§e100mB§f Petroleum Gas + §e1,000mB§f Water + Sulfur in the Chemical Plant) and serious power.

At base level it pumps §e100 mB/s§f crude oil while consuming §e100 kHE/s§f and §e10mB/s§f fracking solution. With Speed 3 and Overdrive 2 you can push it to §e2,000 mB/s§f at §e525 kHE/s§f, and that is the hard cap since the tower can only extract once per tick.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine): §e24×§f Steel Shell, §e12×§f Steel Pipe, §e64×§f Concrete, §e1×§f Titanium Drill, §e2×§f Desh Motor, §e24×§f Desh Compound Plate, §e16×§f Capacitor.

§cWARNING:§f The fracking tower pollutes the surrounding area. It converts grass, stone, and dirt into dead or oily blocks within roughly §e300§f blocks (σ=75). Those blocks kill most plants and fall like sand. Keep it away from anything you care about.

§ePS:§f Before the §bHydrotreater§f, you cannot recycle the fracking solution. Once you have it, both natural gas and crude oil outputs can be processed to recover sulfur components.
